scope: Full-forest asset integration and a repaired bounded contact study; native stills and editable models. Not a finished hyperrealistic environment or a new film.

litter_contact_study.scope: Local metric-preserving settling and sampled supports; neither global collision-free proof nor calibrated cloth physics.

visual_review.inspection_method: Decoded the native 16-bit files, then visually inspected full-frame JPEG display conversions. No cropping or relighting was used to hide scene weaknesses. The ground thumbnail was also inspected; original native PNGs are delivered.
observed_improvements: Native leaf proportions are no longer stretched to the inherited generic blade ratios.
Climbing plants keep one leaf family per vine with distinct mature and juvenile orientation.
Actual referenced shrub and midstory assets contain connected branching hierarchies rather than the earlier sparse lateral template.
Fern fronds vary in length, age, droop, pinna spacing, orientation and damage.
The bounded litter study has less elevated clearance after local metric-constrained settling.
remaining_visible_weaknesses: The forest close-up still has smooth and repeated leaf silhouettes, especially in the dense left-hand shrubs.
The wide shot remains dark in the foreground and reveals repeated upright stems and large simple crown forms.
The large pale bark surfaces and root macrogeometry are inherited; they were not comprehensively remodeled in this repair.
Dead leaves in the contact study still read somewhat leathery or uniformly crumpled, despite better support.
The new render set is static; no wind or temporal stability has been validated.

rejected_test.reason: Reducing broad pigment/bump variation too far produced plain cardboard-like leaves. This model/material variant is not delivered as final.

visual_review.acceptance_scope: Completed native integration repair and contact-study delivery, not an approved finished hyperrealistic rainforest.

native_pipeline: CPU Cycles radiance; independent native material-color and shading-normal guides; exact float32 full-resolution row assembly where required; one full-frame OIDN High/Accurate and one AgX display transform; original 16-bit PNG.
failed_attempts: Concurrent native build/render exhausted worker memory; rerun serially.
Full-frame 1280 x 960 forest attempt was killed before completion; final forest outputs are newly completed native pixel bands.
remaining_limits: Finite species-like families and repeated distant crowns remain.
Large trunk/root macrostructure is inherited from the retained forest.
Litter appearance still needs better decay/boundary variation; sampled contact is not complete collision resolution.
Materials are authored approximations, not measured spectral tissue.
Static forest; no new whole-forest wind or native film in this delivery.
Native validation and larger geometry counts do not certify hyperrealism.
